# @rnw-community/react-native-amount-input

> Auto-fitting amount input and display for React Native (iOS, Android). Measures rendered text to shrink hero amounts
> so they always fit beside their currency symbol; ships amount parsing utilities and a flip sign toggle. ESM + CJS
> precompiled with the React Compiler; peer-depends on react-native-reanimated (>=4.1.0 <5).

## Guides

- [Installation](readme.md#installation): Peer dependencies and supported platforms.
- [Quick start](readme.md#quick-start): An editable hero amount with a prefix symbol.
- [How fitting works](readme.md#how-fitting-works): The measured fit formula and its no-loop guarantee.
- [Recipes](readme.md#recipes): Suffix symbols, keypad-driven displays, custom inputs and signed amounts.

## API reference

- [`AmountField`](readme.md#amountfield): Row that fits its parts to its width.
- [`AmountFieldInput`](readme.md#amountfieldinput): Editable amount part.
- [`AmountFieldText`](readme.md#amountfieldtext): Read-only amount part.
- [`AmountFieldPrefix` / `AmountFieldSuffix`](readme.md#amountfieldprefix--amountfieldsuffix): Currency symbol parts.
- [`AmountSignToggle`](readme.md#amountsigntoggle): Flip toggle between a plus and a minus face.
- [Hooks](readme.md#hooks): `useAmountInput`, `useAmountSign`.
